# Jade CLI 0.4.0

Run Jade scratch code without creating or publishing a class.

- Execute a signature-free `.jade` file in your private Working database.
- Capture `write` output and see native compiler errors with source positions.
- Cancel a run or set a timeout, then continue with another script.

```powershell
jade-cli workspace run scratch.jade --schema MySchema
```

Each run has its own local variables. Committed changes to Working data can persist between runs; Source publication remains separate.

Download `jade-cli-win-x64.zip` and keep its native helpers beside `jade-cli.exe`. A compatible licensed Jade runtime is required.
